foundation.name: OverviewReadSnapshotFactory
foundation.contract: one SQLite read transaction/snapshot shared across all LLD-11 provider calls; no write upgrade or commit path

provider_rules: provider receives the caller's read snapshot and never opens a second authority connection
provider returns accepted-state aggregates plus typed attention/timeline/activity facts, coverage and source freshness; it does not return mutable dashboard records
provider may return coverage unknown/partial/unconfigured without failing the full request
provider never exposes Resolved Status Date or reconstructable communication bodies to Overview
provider-side exact V2 declarations must reconcile to these signatures before LLD-11 can close
